facts.fact: RFI reports that Mali's courts sentenced L'Alternance director Youssouf Sissoko in March 2026 to two years in prison and a one million FCFA fine for publishing an article doubting statements by Niger's President Tiani, with an appeal hearing due on 5 October 2026.

MLI.note: Journalist Chahana Takiou's later imprisonment is stated without a date.
